headline: Schwarber's two homers power Phillies past Twins
recap: The Phillies opened a three-game series with the Twins by winning 7-1 at the Field of Dreams game in Dyersville, Iowa, on Thursday. Philadelphia scored two runs in the first inning, three in the fourth and two more in the seventh; Minnesota's only run came on a second-inning home run by Luke Keaschall off Aaron Nola. Nola (W, 4-9) struck out nine over five innings. Kyle Schwarber went 2-for-5 with two home runs and three RBIs, and Brandon Marsh added a two-run homer while going 2-for-2 with two walks and a stolen base. Trea Turner and Alec Bohm each doubled, and relievers Brooks Raley, Jonathan Bowlan, Jhoan Duran and Orion Kerkering combined for four scoreless innings to close it out. Twins starter Taj Bradley (L, 9-5) allowed five runs over four innings.
Philadelphia is 65-58, second in the NL East, 8.5 games behind the first-place Braves, and is riding a one-game winning streak.

The Phillies took Friday off and continue the series with the Twins Saturday at Target Field in Minneapolis. Jesus Luzardo is set to start for Philadelphia opposite Minnesota's Connor Prielipp, with first pitch at 7:10 PM ET. DraftKings lists the Phillies as -147 favorites on the moneyline.
